description: This file contains a class 'Passwords' that demonstrates PDF password security features, including setting owner and user passwords, and adding hyperlinks to PDF documents.

classes.name: Passwords
classes.description: A class that provides examples of applying password security to PDF documents and adding hyperlinks.

methods.name: Ownerpassword
methods.description: Creates a PDF document with an owner password set.

methods.name: Userpassword
methods.description: Creates a PDF document with a user password set.

methods.name: Bothpasswords
methods.description: Creates a PDF document with both owner and user passwords.

methods.name: AddHyperlink
methods.description: Adds a clickable hyperlink to the last page of the PDF document.
